meta.title: MUTAV reserve ledger: six simulated months (demo chapter 3)
meta.disclaimer: Local simulation, accelerated clock. Surfpool localnet (offline), mock BRS mint, throwaway keys; the clock is warped month by month, so every date is simulated chain time. Not devnet, not mainnet, not real money.

sim_config.issuer_income: (Selic 15% − 1pp) / 12 of the reserve's brs_balance, one statement per month
sim_config.fee_invoices: one per agency per group of up to 3 leases, days 18–25

fields.ts: chain unix seconds (Clock sysvar) right after the op
fields.type: fee | issuer_income | claim_filed | claim_paid | deposit | withdrawal | take_to_treasury | refresh
fields.agency: the agency (display name; on-chain it is an opaque salted id)
fields.ref: invoice ref (fee), issuer statement (income) or lease ref (claims)
fields.amount_brs: signed BRS change of the reserve (stable_assets): + in, − out. claim_filed is 0 (it books a provision); take_to_treasury is 0 (the take never enters the reserve)
fields.provision_brs: claim_filed: the provision booked (lowers net assets and NAV until paid)
fields.gross_brs: fee: the invoice amount paid by the operator
fields.take_brs: fee: the part sent to the MUTAV treasury
fields.treasury_amount_brs: take_to_treasury: + into the MUTAV treasury account
fields.reserve_after: stable_assets (= brs_balance) from coverageFromAccounts, after the op
fields.nav_after: share price: publishedNav(netAssets, sharesOutstanding), the NAV the refresh publishes (net assets = reserve − provisions)
fields.conversion_nav_after: conversionNav(sharesOutstanding, netAssets): the price deposits and redemptions convert at (virtual offset 1)
fields.required_after: coverageRequired from coverageFromAccounts (max(c·cover, provisions + stress term))
fields.ceiling_after: the app's coverageCeiling(...).ceiling (app/lib/charts.ts): the most cover the reserve can carry
fields.signature: the transaction signature (deposits / withdrawals: the admin multisig vault_transaction_execute of the fill)

notes: nav_after is publishedNav (computed live from the accounts after each op), not the NAV stored by the last refresh.

take_to_treasury is not a separate transaction: contribute_fees moves the take straight to the treasury in the same instruction as the fee. It is listed as its own entry with the fee's signature and amount_brs 0, its amount in treasury_amount_brs. sweep_income has no take (ADR 0019).

Deposits and withdrawals are booked when the admin multisig fills the queue (fulfil_deposits / fulfil_redeems), not at request. One fill can fill several requests; each request is its own entry with the same signature and the same after-values.

Lease registrations are not reserve-affecting and are not listed; they move required_after / cover_in_force_after between entries (see active_leases_after). settle_payout only records the PIX end-to-end hash and moves no money; it is not listed.
Capital top-ups by the MUTAV capital wallet are deposits planned by the sim (capitalTopUp) when a month needs room for registrations, payouts and exits.
month 1 nav_start is the share price at the first fill (no shares existed before it).
